name: boolean_literal_function_argument
reason: RexxAE retains the boolean type of a direct function argument; this RexxJS parser path resolves the literal as text. Assigned booleans and JSON_PARSE('true') are compatible.

name: single_quoted_object_keys
reason: RexxAE parses object keys quoted in either style; RexxJS recognizes JSON double-quoted object keys here and leaves the single-quoted form as text.

name: array_literal_function_argument
reason: RexxAE retains direct array literals as typed arguments. RexxJS splits this literal at commas on this call-parser path. Assign the array to a variable for shared syntax.

name: return_result_parser
source:
CALL work
SAY RESULT
EXIT
work:
LET RESULT = 7
RETURN RESULT
reason: RexxJS parses RETURN RESULT as a RESULT() function call and dispatches a default host command. RexxAE reads the variable. Use LET answer = RESULT followed by RETURN answer for shared syntax.

name: condition_multiple_function_terms
source:
SELECT
WHEN ABS(2) + ABS(3) > 4 THEN SAY 'match'
OTHERWISE SAY 'fallback'
END
reason: The RexxJS condition resolver consumes this compound function expression as one function call. RexxAE evaluates the arithmetic expression. Assign the sum to a variable before WHEN for shared syntax.

name: explicit_parse_with
source:
LET line = 'one two three'
PARSE VAR line WITH a b
SAY a
SAY b
PARSE VALUE line WITH a b
SAY a
SAY b
reason: RexxJS treats WITH as a template variable in these parser paths. RexxAE recognizes the explicit separator. Omit WITH for the shared simple-input profile.

name: object_assignment_aliases
source:
LET data.x = 7
LET alias = data
LET data.x = 8
SAY alias.x data.x
reason: RexxAE owns copied values; RexxJS shares object identity across variable assignment. This difference now has an observable compound-write example.
